claims.statement: Discussion practices recommend pointed/follow-up questions, diverse feedback synthesis and an actionable issue where appropriate; these are collaboration recommendations, not mandatory gates or evidence of decision accuracy.

Discussions support discovery/big-picture brainstorming and detail development before scoped issues in illustrative workflows; no requirement that every issue pass through discussion or that discussions be universally enabled.

Repository discussions suit repository-specific topics; organization discussions may suit projects spanning repositories. This preserves function-owned polyrepo rather than prescribing monorepo consolidation.
Issues support specific bug/planned-improvement detail and PRs support comments on proposed changes; surface choice does not establish implementation, accepted policy or verified review.
Polls measure expressed interest/opinion, not representative community census, truth, safety or binding acceptance.

Before opening discussion, check for contributing guidance; existing CONTRIBUTING explains maintainer preference, but file existence does not verify content adequacy, current authorization or every participant compliance.
Quickstart and community/template/moderation/writing links are next-step references; this file does not supply their full rules, operational enforcement or rights clearance.
